articles.title: Self Hosted Crashed after adding S3

articles.summary: I installed openreplay with a domain name that I’d now like to change. I see openreplay -–edit allows me to change the domain name, but doing so doesn’t seem to propagate to the wide variety of Ingress/Deployment resources that are still using the old name. Do I have to update all of these one by one? Is there a better way to change the domain name on an existing deployment?
articles.title: Changing the domain name for an existing deployment
